publisher: UK Office for National Statistics; indicator data sourced from Ofcom
title: 5G outdoor geographic coverage, UK local areas, January 2026
metadataChecked: The ONS page defines the metric as percentage of geographic area with outdoor 5G signal from at least one operator at a -110 dBm threshold, dated January 2026, and identifies Ofcom data published 13 May 2026. The page offers this XLSX and shows the site-level Open Government Licence v3.0 notice except where stated.

readOnlyWorkbookScreen.indicatorDefinition: Percentage of geographic area with outdoor 5G signal from at least one operator at a -110 dBm threshold, January 2026

localExposureScreen.limitation: Exact hash absence does not prove semantic or question-level independence.

draftQuestions.question: 按 ONS 2026 年 1 月 5G 覆盖工作簿，Aberdeen City 与 Aberdeenshire 的室外 5G 地理面积覆盖率各是多少？两地相差多少个百分点？
draftQuestions.draftAnswer: Aberdeen City 为 99.85%，Aberdeenshire 为 64.20%，相差 35.65 个百分点。
draftQuestions.calculation: C381 minus C382, expressed in percentage points

draftQuestions.question: 按同一工作簿，Highland 与 Scotland 的 2026 年 1 月 5G 覆盖比例分别是多少，Highland 低多少个百分点？这里的比例描述地理面积、住户还是人口？
draftQuestions.draftAnswer: Highland 为 35.20%，Scotland 为 47.52%，Highland 低 12.32 个百分点。指标描述至少一家运营商在室外达到 −110 dBm 信号阈值的地理面积比例，并非住户或人口比例。
draftQuestions.calculation: C395 minus C370, expressed in percentage points
